hero.title:
Redefining Hiring with
AI-Powered Interviews
hero.description: LetsHyre is an AI-powered hiring platform designed to help employers discover, evaluate, and connect with experienced professionals who are actively seeking new career opportunities.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: To simplify hiring by combining artificial intelligence with transparent candidate evaluation, helping employers discover qualified talent efficiently while providing experienced professionals with fair opportunities to showcase their capabilities.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: To become the most trusted AI-powered hiring marketplace for experienced professionals, enabling employers to make better hiring decisions and helping candidates connect with meaningful career opportunities.

intro.title:
The Challenge
& Our Solution
intro.p1: Traditional hiring processes often require significant time and effort to screen resumes, conduct interviews, and identify the right candidates. LetsHyre streamlines this process through intelligent candidate screening, AI-powered role-based interviews, interview scorecards, and transparent candidate evaluation.
intro.p2: Our platform enables employers to unlock candidate profiles, interview scorecards, interview recordings, and contact information through a simple Pay-Per-Unlock model.

aiPowered.title: AI-Powered Hiring
aiPowered.desc: Role-based AI interviews help employers evaluate candidates more efficiently.

faster.title: Faster Hiring
faster.desc: Reduce manual screening effort and accelerate hiring decisions.

network.title: Experienced Talent Network
network.desc: Connect with immediate joiners, notice-period professionals, and experienced candidates actively seeking opportunities.

payPerUnlock.title: Pay-Per-Unlock Model
payPerUnlock.desc: Pay only when you choose to unlock candidate information relevant to your hiring needs.

transparency.title: Interview Transparency
transparency.desc: Structured interview scorecards and insights support informed hiring decisions.

profileDuration.title: Profile Activity Duration
profileDuration.p1: To maintain a high-quality and actively available talent pool, candidate profiles remain active on the platform for up to 90 days from the date of profile creation.
profileDuration.p2: Candidates may update their profile information during this period.
profileDuration.p3: After the 90-day period expires, candidate profiles may be permanently removed from the active LetsHyre candidate pool.
profileDuration.p4: Candidates who wish to continue using LetsHyre after profile removal may create a new profile, subject to the platform's policies and requirements.

commitment.title: Disclaimer
commitment.body: LetsHyre provides AI-assisted interview and candidate screening services. AI-generated scorecards and insights are intended to support hiring decisions and should not be considered the sole basis for employment decisions. Final hiring decisions remain the responsibility of employers.
